name: MathCAMPS
summary: 9,707 synthetic math word problems, each tied to one of 44 Common Core standards for grades K to 8, with follow-up questions.

license.note: The problems were written by language models from a grammar for each standard; the repository also holds over 220,000 model responses.

made_by: Shubhra Mishra, Gabriel Poesia and Noah D. Goodman
cite: Mishra, S., Poesia, G., & Goodman, N. D. (2025). From Next-Token to Mathematics: The Learning Dynamics of Mathematical Reasoning in Language Models. COLM 2025. arXiv:2407.00900

fits.how: No slot yet: its problems, with answers and standards, could be agent test cases for an activity's standard.
